tips.text: Last-hit minions with Super Scorcher Breath early; each kill adds a Dragon Practice stack and refunds some Mana.
Smolder is weak early, so farm safely and stack Dragon Practice rather than taking risky fights.
Hit enemy champions with Achooo! from long range; it leaves them slowed and the explosion hurts anyone standing next to them.
Use Flap, Flap, Flap to escape or to reposition over walls. Casting another ability ends the flight, so don't cast anything else if you want to keep flying.
Hard crowd control stops Flap, Flap, Flap, so don't use it to escape while an enemy can stun you.
Aim MMOOOMMMM! so the enemy is in the center of the blast. The center hits harder and leaves them slowed, and it heals you if it hits you.
Stay close to your support and fight when enemies are bunched up. Smolder relies on allies to keep him safe.
Play safe early and farm with Super Scorcher Breath to build Dragon Practice stacks; you are weak until you have them.
Aphelios has more range with Calibrum, so don't stand in his line of fire; hit him with Achooo! to make him slowed and cut his poke short.
Watch for the purple Gravitum gun; once you are slowed by it, he can root you. Keep Flap, Flap, Flap ready to get away.
Use MMOOOMMMM! when he and his support are close together; the center hits hardest and slows.
Play safe early and last-hit with Super Scorcher Breath to build Dragon Practice stacks; you are weak until they come in.
Ashe has few escapes, so land Achooo! to slow her and trade when she steps up.
Stay away from where Ashe can hit you with Volley and Enchanted Crystal Arrow; if you are stunned and caught alone, you die.
Keep Flap, Flap, Flap to escape or to chase; any stun or other hard crowd control on you ends it.
Ashe's Volley is blocked by minions, so stand behind your minions when she aims at you.
Stay out of Brand's Sear line and keep minions between you; it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Don't stand beside your support. Brand's Conflagration and Pyroclasm hit groups hardest.
Walk sideways when Brand casts Pillar of Flame; it lands after a short delay and is easy to sidestep.
Poke Brand with Achooo! when he steps up; it reaches far and leaves him slowed.
Play safe early and farm with Super Scorcher Breath to build stacks, since you are weak before then.
Focus on farming and staying alive early. Your Super Scorcher Breath kills on minions build Dragon Practice for later.
Step over to the side of minions when Caitlyn fires Piltover Peacemaker. Standing behind them makes it hit you for less.
Watch where you walk. Caitlyn's Yordle Snap Trap roots you, and then she hits hard with a Headshot.
When Caitlyn backs off, slow her to keep her in range with Achooo!
Use Flap, Flap, Flap to cross walls and escape, or to hit her after a trade. It ends if you cast another ability or get stunned.
Stay out of Cassiopeia's Noxious Blast range and sidestep it, since it lands after a short delay. Twin Fang hurts a lot when you are poisoned.
Poke her with Achooo! from long range, since it slows her and she can't easily answer from that far.
Don't use Flap, Flap, Flap to escape through her Miasma. It leaves you grounded and slowed, and flight can be interrupted by hard crowd control.
Face away from Cassiopeia when she casts Petrifying Gaze, so you are slowed instead of stunned.
Stack Dragon Practice safely with Super Scorcher Breath on minions and survive early. Later you out-range and outdamage her.
Stay safe early and farm with Super Scorcher Breath; killing minions with it builds your Dragon Practice stacks.
Corki outranges you with Phosphorus Bomb, so keep out of its area and step away when it lands.
Use Achooo! to hit Corki from long range; the slow gives you room to follow up or walk away.
Hide behind minions only for the first missile; Missile Barrage explodes and hurts you even behind them.
Hit Corki when he lands after Valkyrie; he is easier to catch then.
Play safe early and stack Dragon Practice by hitting champions with Achooo! from long range, not by trading with Draven.
Aim Super Scorcher Breath and Achooo! at where Draven's Spinning Axe will land; making him miss it cuts his power.
Do not stand in a straight line with Draven when he has Stand Aside ready; the knockback and slow leave you open.
Save Flap, Flap, Flap to escape or reposition. Draven's knockback or other hard crowd control can end it.
Aim Achooo! at Ezreal when he walks up to poke; it slows him and its explosion hurts when it hits a champion.
Stand behind minions so Ezreal's Mystic Shot hits them first; it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Last-hit with Super Scorcher Breath to build Dragon Practice and refund mana. Stay safe early, since you are weak.
Ezreal is fragile. Once he spends Arcane Shift, go in with Flap, Flap, Flap to chase him.
Ezreal's Essence Flux marks you for a bigger hit. Step out of its path, or he can pop it with an attack.
Stay out of the line of Hwei's spells early and farm with Super Scorcher Breath; you are weak before you have stacks.
Sneeze Achooo! from long range to slow Hwei and hit him with the explosion, then follow up if he has used his spells.
Rush Hwei once he has painted a Torment spell. He is easy to catch right after casting it.
Keep moving when Hwei is lined up on you. Severing Bolt hits harder on an isolated target, so stay near your support.
Use Flap, Flap, Flap to escape or to reposition. It ends if you are immobilized, so don't take it when you are already crowd controlled.
Stay alive and farm early with Super Scorcher Breath on minions; every kill adds Dragon Practice stacks.
Do not stand near allies or enemies when Jhin can hit you with Deadly Flourish; being damaged first means it roots you.
Walk carefully in bushes and river, since Jhin hides Captive Audience traps there. Stepping on one slows you.
Jump Jhin when he empties his fourth shot of Whisper and has to reload, and use Achooo! to slow him.
Use Flap, Flap, Flap to escape or reposition. It ignores terrain, but any stun or root will stop it.
Stack Dragon Practice by last-hitting with Super Scorcher Breath and landing Achooo! on Jinx; stay alive early.
Stay out of a straight line from Jinx, because Zap! leaves you slowed.
Wait for Flame Chompers! to be used before you dive, since she struggles to escape without it.
Don't fly into the chompers with Flap, Flap, Flap. Being rooted ends your flight.
Rush Jinx while she pokes with rockets; her minigun takes time to ramp up.
Stay safe early and farm with Super Scorcher Breath. It refunds mana when it kills, and every stack you gain makes you stronger.
Slow Kai'Sa to keep her off you, since the explosion adds extra damage when you hit her with Achooo!
Do not stand in the open when Kai'Sa has Plasma on you. Killer Instinct lets her jump in and burst you.
Kai'Sa's Void Seeker has long range and shows where you are. Move around it and don't stand still.
Save the heal for when you are caught, and aim the center of the wave to slow her with MMOOOMMMM!
Stay safe early and last-hit with Super Scorcher Breath; each minion it kills adds a Dragon Practice stack.
Kalista dashes a lot, so land Achooo! when she commits to an attack; it slows her and cuts her mobility.
Kalista cannot cancel her attack windup. Hit her with Achooo! as she starts an attack.
Her Rend slows you and deals more damage the more spears are stuck in you. Back off once you have taken several spears.
Her ally can use Fate's Call to come in and knock you up, so keep Flap, Flap, Flap ready to escape.
Stay out of Lay Waste range early and focus on farming safely so Dragon Practice stacks can build.
Hit Karthus with Achooo! from long range; it slows him and he has no quick way to dodge.
Avoid walking through Wall of Pain; it slows you and makes you take more magic damage.
Do not fly into Defile with Flap, Flap, Flap unless you can kill; its damage ticks add up while you are close.
Stay clear of Karthus's body after he dies; he can still cast spells for a few seconds.
Keep your health high late in the game; Requiem hits you from anywhere once its channel finishes.
Stay out of the Void Ooze trail; it slows you and leaves you easy to hit.
Hit Kog'Maw with Achooo! when he comes forward to attack; he has no good escape.
Use Flap, Flap, Flap to dash in on Kog'Maw, or to get away from his Caustic Spittle.
Hit minions with Super Scorcher Breath to build Dragon Practice safely. Kog'Maw's range makes trading in lane risky.
Stay safe early and farm with Super Scorcher Breath; last-hit kills refund mana and build your Dragon Practice stacks.
Land Achooo! on Lucian when he dashes in; the slow lets you back away from his burst.
Lucian has strong burst but little sustained damage, so back off after his dash and abilities are spent.
Step out of the line of The Culling; Lucian cannot change its angle once he starts it.
Do not use Flap, Flap, Flap to fight Lucian early; Lucian can stop it by being stunned or rooted, but it mostly works for escaping or finishing.
Sidestep Light Binding, since it only hits the first two enemies in its path. If a minion is in front of you, it may take the hit for you.
Stay out of Lucent Singularity. Being slowed in it makes you easy to hit with Light Binding.
Hit Lux with Achooo! from long range, since it slows her and she has little health to spare.
Farm safely and build up Dragon Practice stacks. Hit Lux with your abilities to gain more stacks.
When you see the red warning line of Final Spark, step to the side. Do not stand in a line with your teammates.
Play safe early and focus on building stacks with Super Scorcher Breath on minions; you are weak until Dragon Practice grows.
Land Achooo! on Miss Fortune; she is slowed and takes the explosion, and hitting a champion grows your stacks.
Stay out of her Make It Rain area; it slows you and she can then walk onto you.
Don't stand in a line with minions or allies for Double Up to bounce through, and don't stay in front of Bullet Time.
Stay safe early and farm with Super Scorcher Breath to build Dragon Practice; Nilah punishes you if you trade carelessly.
Hit Nilah with Achooo! at long range so she is slowed; do not let her get in close with Slipstream.
Wait out Jubilant Veil before attacking; she dodges basic attacks while it lasts.
Do not fight Nilah once Apotheosis is up and your support is away; it pulls you in and heals her.
Use Flap, Flap, Flap to escape over walls when Nilah dives in.
Stay out of melee range early; Samira's Wild Rush and Flair hit hard when she gets close. Poke her with Super Scorcher Breath instead.
Don't throw Achooo! while Samira has Blade Whirl ready; she can destroy the glob. Bait it out first.
Use Flap, Flap, Flap to escape when Samira dashes at you, but she can still chase, so stay near your support.
Keep Smolder's Achooo! slow for when Samira commits; slowed, she is easier to hit and kite.
Play safe early and farm with Super Scorcher Breath; every minion it kills adds a Dragon Practice stack.
Dodge Senna's Last Embrace; it roots you for a long time and she gets free damage on you.
Use Achooo! to slow Senna when she walks up to poke, then follow with Super Scorcher Breath.
Save Flap, Flap, Flap for escaping or finishing a fight; Senna's Last Embrace root cuts it short.
Stay safe and farm early, since you are weak now; last-hit with Super Scorcher Breath to build Dragon Practice stacks.
Wait for Sivir to use Spell Shield on something cheap before you throw Achooo!, since one shield blocks it.
Stay out of Boomerang Blade's path both ways; if it hits you going out, move off that line before it returns.
Do not stand beside your minions when Sivir has Ricochet active; the bounces reach you from them.
Use Flap, Flap, Flap to escape or to chase, but remember being stunned ends it.
Play safe early and farm with Super Scorcher Breath; every minion it kills builds Dragon Practice stacks.
Hit Tristana with Achooo! when she steps up; the glob leaves her slowed and the explosion adds damage.
Stay away from her Buster Shot range when you are low on health; it knocks you back and stuns you.
Back off when a bomb from Explosive Charge is on you; hits on you grow it, so avoid trading until it goes off.
Use Flap, Flap, Flap to cross walls and escape her Rocket Jump engage, but not while she has Buster Shot ready.
Play safe early and farm with Super Scorcher Breath; every minion it kills adds to Dragon Practice.
Aim Achooo! at Twitch when he steps up to attack; hitting him slows him and adds an explosion.
Twitch is fragile, so burst him down with Super Scorcher Breath when he shows himself after camouflage.
Do not stand in Venom Cask's cloud; it slows you and piles on Deadly Venom for Contaminate.
Flap, Flap, Flap can carry you over walls to escape Twitch, but it ends if you are stunned or cast another ability.
Play safe early and last-hit with Super Scorcher Breath to gain stacks; you are weak until they build.
Dodge Piercing Arrow by watching Varus charge it, and step out of the line. He is slowed while he charges.
Hit Varus with Achooo! when he charges an arrow; the slow and explosion make him pay for standing still.
Keep Flap, Flap, Flap ready to escape Chain of Corruption's range, but it won't free you once you are rooted.
Leave the Hail of Arrows ground quickly; it slows you and cuts your healing.
Stay alive and farm with Super Scorcher Breath to build Dragon Practice stacks; your early game is weak.
Stay away from walls when Vayne has Condemn ready; a wall hit stuns you and deals heavy damage.
Land Achooo! when Vayne walks up to you; it slows her so she can't close in or escape easily.
Don't trade when Vayne has Silver Bolts on her third hit; back off after two hits.
Use Flap, Flap, Flap to escape over walls, not while Vayne has Condemn up; stuns end the flight.
Stay out of Dark Matter's marked circle; it falls after a short delay, so keep moving when Veigar aims at you.
Don't walk through the edge of Event Horizon. If you stand inside it you can still move and attack, only the edge stuns.
Land Achooo! on Veigar to leave him slowed, then punish him since he is fragile.
Stack Dragon Practice safely by hitting champions with abilities and last-hitting with Super Scorcher Breath; don't force early trades.
Keep minions between you and Veigar so Baleful Strike can't reach you cleanly; it only hits the first two enemies.
Play safe early and farm with Super Scorcher Breath; each minion it kills adds a stack of Dragon Practice.
Hit Xayah with Achooo! to slow her, then follow up with a basic ability while she is slowed.
Step off the ground Feathers when Xayah is ready to cast Bladecaller; being hit by three or more roots you.
Do not cast MMOOOMMMM! at Xayah when she can use Featherstorm; she becomes untargetable and dodges it.
Do not fly in with Flap, Flap, Flap while Bladecaller is ready; a root would stop you in the middle of her team.
Sneeze with Achooo! when Yasuo has used Wind Wall; it is the best time to slow him and explode on him.
Wait out Wind Wall before firing Super Scorcher Breath; the wall destroys the fireball.
Stay safe early and farm up Dragon Practice stacks; you are weak before they build.
Stay away from the Steel Tempest whirlwind; being knocked up lets Yasuo follow with Last Breath.
Fly with Flap, Flap, Flap to escape a Yasuo dash, but stun or knock-up will end it early.
Stay safe and farm with Super Scorcher Breath early; every kill adds a stack of Dragon Practice and returns mana.
Land Achooo! from long range on Yunara; it slows her and the explosion adds damage when it hits her.
Back off when Yunara's Cultivation of Spirit is active; her attacks hit faster and spread to nearby enemies, you included.
Don't stand in a line with your support when Yunara fires her prayer bead; it can slow and hit you both.
Save Flap, Flap, Flap to escape over walls after Yunara uses her ultimate. Her Arc of Ruin will slow you if it hits.
Stay alive and farm with Super Scorcher Breath; last-hit kills give you stacks, so do not take risky trades early.
Aim Achooo! at Zeri when she lines up with her support; it slows her and the explosion hurts anyone close.
Zeri can dash over walls with Spark Surge, so keep Flap, Flap, Flap ready to escape or chase when she jumps in.
Save MMOOOMMMM! for when Zeri is slowed or committed; the center hit slows and hurts the most.
Stay out of Hexplosive Minefield mines. Walking through them slows you and sets up Ziggs's other spells.
Trade right after Ziggs uses Bouncing Bomb or Satchel Charge, because both have long cooldowns.
Use Achooo! from long range to slow Ziggs and keep him back from the lane.
Last-hit minions with Super Scorcher Breath early to build Dragon Practice stacks. Stay out of Ziggs's poke range while you do.
Don't stand still when Ziggs is in range of Mega Inferno Bomb. Its blast is slow to land, so move out of the circle.
